limitations: Earlier cbc36c54-c909-4dcf-9c79-2e9911969ad7 had two denied candidate test commands and omitted rationale from judge input; it is not counted as full acceptance.
This is separate-directory isolation with explicit ownership, not an OS-enforced writer sandbox. The trivial fixture yielded identical fixes and does not prove diverse solutions for a complex task.
The test prompt explicitly required full rationale/test handoff and immutable hashes.

assertions.evidence: cef4fd24-be30-46bb-b8b9-e3d74c2f96d6: three named runners owned separate candidate directories; root owned final/page.mjs.
